topic: How do crosslink requirements in mesh satellite architectures affect feeder link budgets and overall system cost per Mbps?
response: Crosslink requirements in mesh satellite architectures increase feeder link budgets due to additional transmission power and bandwidth allocated for inter-satellite communication. This leads to higher system cost per Mbps as more resources are devoted to maintaining network connectivity and ensuring QoS guarantees.
reference_context: The context highlights the importance of managing available capacity, link up/down detection, and admission control in satellite networks. It also mentions the need for considering high fixed latencies on links and the limitation of current systems in providing detailed link status information.
